title: Drawback Chess, But My Paranoia is All-Consuming
summary: Long Drawback Chess session (~31 min) online vs anonymous humans; the narrator sees his own drawback for only about two seconds at game start, then must remember/deduce it, which feeds his 'paranoia' (seeing drawbacks everywhere). Goal: win one game. Game 1 (White): his drawback was 'Vacation/Holiday' (no drawback at all); opponent's 'Centralized command' (can only capture if you moved your king in the last three turns). Other games: opponent 'Cowardly' (when your opponent captures, you must move backwards or lose); 'Shapeshifter' (your queen starts as a bishop and turns into whatever she captures); his own: a drawback where the allowed side of the board (left/right) flips after each capture, and one where whether you may move left or right is random each turn.
rules: Standard start; Drawback Chess king-capture rules (no check; capture king to win; failing some drawbacks = loss).
Own drawback shown for ~2 seconds then hidden; opponent's hidden until the end; you may reveal your drawback to the opponent if you guess it.

Drawbacks seen: Vacation/Holiday (no drawback); Centralized command (can only capture if you've moved your king in the last three turns); Cowardly (when opponent captures you must move backwards or lose); Death wish (if you can move into check you must); Shapeshifter (queen starts as a bishop, becomes whatever piece type she captures); side-switching drawback (after each capture you switch which half - left or right - you can move to); random left/right restriction each turn.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king (or opponent fails their drawback); goal: win one game.

opponent.name: Random online human (drawback chess site)
opponent.avatar_description: Anonymous random names, e.g. '... green monkey'.

board.theme_notes: cream/brown board on purple Drawback UI; many pink/red forbidden squares; green arrows; 'That's not FAIR' cat thumbnail.

current_impl_issues: Legacy uses homebrew 14-item list ('pieces cannot retreat' etc.) hidden; no 2-second flash, no king capture, none of the conditional drawbacks (Centralized command, Cowardly, Shapeshifter, side-switching).
